description.zh:
域名列表，英文逗号隔开；仅支持阿里云注册的域名。<props="china">域名名称可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">域名名称可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
description.en:
The domain names to transfer. Separate multiple domain names with commas. Only domain names registered with Alibaba Cloud are supported. <props="china">To get your domain names, call [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
<props="intl">To get your domain names, call [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>

description.zh:
请求值，返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：zh
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: zh.

description.zh: 将云解析列表中的域名和解析记录转移到目标用户ID下。
description.en: The ID of the target user account. The specified domain names and their DNS records are transferred to this account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns transfer-domain --lang en --domain-names example.com,example.net --remark test_domain_transfer --target-user-id 120000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns TransferDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Lang en --DomainNames 'example.com,example.net' --Remark test_domain_transfer --TargetUserId 120000000
